examples.en: We heard a warbler singing in the garden tree.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi nghe thấy một con chim chích hót trên cây trong vườn.

thesaurus.definition: a singer; usually a singer who adds embellishments to the song
a small active songbird

wiktionary.gloss: Any of various small passerine songbirds, especially of the family Sylviidae (Old World warblers) and Parulidae (New World warblers).
One who warbles.
A device that makes a warbling sound.
A hissy fit.

examples:
2021, Mary Hargreaves, Enough Already, pag:?
Ben comes out of his study as I emerge onto the landing.
'Wit woo,' he whistles, 'you look amazing.'
Thanks!

Marie let out a low whistle, “wit woo, you are one foxy lady!“
